items.description: Electrician labour checking/rewiring flooded circuits, 12 hrs
items.rationale: Surface-water flooding is inundation under 2.1(c2), and the schedule is not said to record that group. The 3.6 bar therefore removes all labour (3.6.2(b)). If it were covered: 12 hrs x ~85.
Every journey charge is barred under 3.6.2(f) because the inundation peril is not insured. If covered, this would be the one journey charge allowed under 7.1.7(g), at about 79.
This is working equipment: not insured property (4.3(d)) and not indemnified alongside the measure it served (5.2.2). The 3.6 bar also applies.
Working equipment used for the water-extraction measure, excluded under 5.2.2 and 7.1.8(b). The 3.6 bar also applies.
This is a loss-mitigation measure, barred by 3.6.2(d)/(g) because inundation (c2) is not recorded as insured. If covered, priced as a measure.
Materials are barred under 3.6.2(c). If covered, small consumables would be allowed under 7.1.7(c).

items.description: Renew boiler incl. flue and storage tank
items.rationale: Replacement of building plant is barred under 3.6.2(a); the rain flooding is not an insured peril here. If covered, renewal at standard grade.

items.description: Adjust supply pipework for replacement boiler
items.rationale: Adaptation work belonging to the replacement is barred under 3.6.2(a). If covered, it would be allowed under 7.1.7(d).
Disposal is barred under 3.6.2(e). If covered, it would fall under 5.2.1.
Barred under 3.6.2(f). Even if the claim were covered, this is a second journey charge for the same event and excluded under 7.1.8(d).
